question: Aqua City nằm ở đâu thuộc Đồng Nai, giá/m² biệt thự ở đó so với trung vị biệt thự cả tỉnh Đồng Nai chênh bao nhiêu %?

question: Sau sáp nhập 2025, Bình Dương thuộc tỉnh/thành nào; giá nhà/m² trung vị của Bình Dương bằng bao nhiêu % so với TP.HCM (cũ)?
gt_sql: WITH m AS (SELECT any_value(province_2025) AS province_2025 FROM v_listings WHERE province = 'Bình Dương'), b AS (SELECT median(price_m2_mil) AS m, count(*) AS n FROM v_listings WHERE deal_type = 'sale' AND price_m2_mil IS NOT NULL AND property_type = 'Nhà' AND province = 'Bình Dương'), h AS (SELECT median(price_m2_mil) AS m, count(*) AS n FROM v_listings WHERE deal_type = 'sale' AND price_m2_mil IS NOT NULL AND property_type = 'Nhà' AND province = 'Hồ Chí Minh') SELECT round(b.m / h.m * 100, 2) AS pct_of_hcm, m.province_2025, b.m AS binh_duong_median_price_m2_mil, h.m AS hcm_median_price_m2_mil, b.n AS n_binh_duong, h.n AS n_hcm FROM m, b, h

question: Vinhomes Smart City ở quận nào, và trong quận đó phường nào có giá/m² căn hộ trung vị thấp nhất (từ 20 tin)?
gt_sql: WITH p AS (SELECT province, mode(district) AS district FROM v_listings WHERE project = 'Vinhomes Smart City' AND province = 'Hà Nội' AND district IS NOT NULL GROUP BY province), w AS (SELECT v.ward, median(v.price_m2_mil) AS m, count(*) AS n FROM v_listings v JOIN p ON v.province = p.province AND v.district = p.district WHERE v.deal_type = 'sale' AND v.price_m2_mil IS NOT NULL AND v.property_type = 'Căn hộ chung cư' AND v.ward IS NOT NULL GROUP BY v.ward HAVING count(*) >= 20 ORDER BY m ASC LIMIT 1) SELECT w.ward, p.district, w.m AS ward_median_price_m2_mil, w.n AS n_ward FROM p, w
